item.title: Walleye survive late burst to defeat Cincinnati
item.description: The Toledo Walleye ran their winning streak to four games on Friday with a 3-2 victory over the Cincinnati Cyclones at the Huntington Center.

item.title: Photo Gallery: Genoa vs. Paulding Division V district final
item.description: Genoa defeated Paulding to claim its first district title in 30 years at Napoleon High School on March 6.

item.title: Matthew Tkachuk has hat trick, Panthers beat Red Wings 3-1 to end 4-game losing streak
item.description: DETROIT — Matthew Tkachuk had his sixth career hat trick and the Florida Panthers beat the Detroit Red Wings 3-1 on Friday night to snap a four-game losing streak.

item.title: Photo Gallery: Student-led iftar dinner at Ottawa Hills
item.description: A student-led Iftar Dinner hosted by the Ottawa Hills Muslim Student Association took place at Ottawa Hills Elementary School in Toledo on March 6.

item.title: Bowling Green hockey drops Game 1 of the Mason Cup playoffs to Michigan Tech
item.description: HOUGHTON, Mich. — Bowling Green State University opened its Central Collegiate Hockey Association best-of-three quarterfinal series with a 5-3 loss at Michigan Tech during the Mason Cup playoffs.

item.title: High school basketball: Patrick Henry falls to Colonel Crawford in Div. V district final
item.description: WILLARD, Ohio — A four-point Colonel Crawford lead after the first quarter quickly ballooned to a 13-point lead at the midway point over Patrick Henry, allowing the Eagles to pick up a 68-55 Division V district title win on Friday.

item.title: Explosions rock Iran's capital, and more attacks target Israel as U.S. warns bombing will intensify
item.description: DUBAI, United Arab Emirates — Explosions sent up clouds of dark smoke in the Iranian capital city early Saturday, and Tehran retaliated by firing missiles at Israel as the United States warned of a forthcoming bombing campaign that officials said would be the most intense yet in the weeklong conflict.

item.title: Bowling Green men's basketball closes regular season with road win over Eastern Michigan
item.description: YPSILANTI, Mich. — Javontae Campbell played nearly the entire game, and scored a game-high 22 points and dished out seven assists during Bowling Green State University’s 77-69 win over Mid-American Conference foe Eastern Michigan during its regular-season finale on Friday.

item.title: Big Ten Women's Roundup: Ohio State set to take on UCLA in semis
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS — Elsa Lemmila had 17 points and 11 rebounds, Jaloni Cambridge also scored 17, and No. 11 Ohio State beat No. 19 Minnesota 60-55 on Friday in the quarterfinals of the Big Ten Tournament.
